story_text:
Hello- we're Silver Fox Tools and back with our forth Kickstarter campaign.
We are a Everyday Carry (EDC) company based in the Highlands of Scotland, designing functional pocket tools and leather wallets with a vintage aesthetic. Built to be legacy pieces, the Silver Fox Tools logo is a hallmark of excellence, and our EDC products are intended to be items passed down the generations.
## THE DAVY TORCH
'Be prepared' is one of the best Scout moto's. We love it. In two words it captures a readiness to take on everyday challenges. We worked out if you had to boil it down to 3 tools, it would be a Knife, Pen and Torch.
When we started on the project to design a torch we didn't just want to follow the norm. We wanted a torch that had classic form a modern day function. A tool that you enjoy using. We wanted it to have the efficiency of modern LED technology while having a familiar nostalgic look. So we looked to the past for inspiration.
## THE INSPIRATION
Designed in the early 19th century to save coal miners lives, the Davy lamp had a unmistakable silhouette that was made for a world very different from today — yet more than two centuries later it captured our imagination.
We love Its materials, form and function and wanted to build a homage to it.
## THE DESIGN
This torch isn't just made to look good. We believe tools are there to be used, carried on adventures, kept in the workshop, taken camping, stored in the car or simply left by the back door for those moments when you need a reliable source of light.
Made to honor an icon. Built to be used everyday.
## THE SPECIFICATIONS
- Grade 5 Titanium or Solid Brass Body.
- Length 114mm/5.5 inches
- Width at lamp end 22mm/0.8inches
- Lanyard end 11mm/0.43 inches
- Weight Titanium 75 grams
- Weight Brass 120 grams
- AAA 350mAh USB rechargeable battery
- LED - Nichia 519A R9080 4000k
- IPX6 Water resistance
We used premium grade materials with a raw brushed finish. Titanium for a light weight carry and brass for those who love patina.
With a warm white LED (CCT 3685k) and 3 power modes they give vintage color with a powerful performance. The result is something that looks like it belongs in another era, but performs like a torch built for today.
LOW : 17 Lumens /Beam distance 4m
MEDIUM : 97 Lumens / 120mins run time / 37m
HIGH : 241 Lumens / 60 mins run time / Beam Distance 63m
[Can be programed to unlock more modes, including strobe]
## ADD-ON
A lanyard with function.
We didn't just want to make an ordinary leather sheath with a clip and call it done. Versitility is the key for this leather Lanyard. Yes its simple. But sometimes thats all that needed. Keep it attached as a lanyard or on your belt. It looks good and at the same time gives you real use case options. We see this as a perfect way to loop it round branches while your setting up the fire, attach it to a car bonnet in a breakdown or hang it in your tent to provide a hanging lamp.
The real beauty of this as a lanyard is you have quick access to your torch from your belt at a moments notice. The torch can be used while still attached to your belt.
## THE TEAM
We love what we do, so we do what we love. The team at Silver Fox share a passion for cool design and products that last and improve over time.
## OUR PROMISE
The EDC (Everyday Carry) community at its heart is about being prepared to make and mend. We are focused to give you tools with innovative design and high quality from the best craftsman we can find. Making heirloom tools that you would be proud to pass down the generations.
We send our tools into the hands of people all over the would, making the ownership of a Silver Fox Tools product something you can be proud to own.
We are a small team with honour and passion and we will do whatever it takes to give you the best customer experience. You can connect with us and be confident we will get back to you.
Every day since starting Silver Fox in 2021 we get a kick out of seeing the EDC (Every Day Carry) community enjoying using our tools. We are proud to make something you love as much as we do and we will always strive to design and make the very best tools for the EDC community.
As with our other products, The Davy Torch comes with a guarantee for life, our commitment to creating legacy tools.
## PROJECT TIMELINE
This is our current project timeline based on 1000 torches. We know that building a product can throw up unforeseen challenges (See risks below) . Our pledge to you is to always remain transparent on our status, informing you updates as manufacturing begins.
## THANKS
for taking the time to look at our project.
Whether you're drawn to its vintage aesthetic, fascinated by industrial design, love beautifully made objects, or simply want a torch that looks as good on your desk as it does in your hand — we'd love you to be part of the journey.
Dave & The Team
risks: This is our forth Kickstarter campaign, and we are not new to producing quality tools. That said, while there maybe new unforeseen challenges, we feel we have allocated time to overcome any possible hurdles.
